paragraphs: Spain is one of the most popular markets for buying resort housing. The reasons for the increased demand are unsurpassed climatic conditions and optimal balance of value, quality, and flow of tourists and investment attractiveness for the investor. Besides, rental housing has become the preferred accommodation for many travellers

In the case of a short-term rental, the owner of the apartment is looking for tenants almost daily, not once every few months or years. This minimises downtime. To do this, we use all available marketing tools and methods. Booking and Airbnb are the most popular apartment search services for short-term rentals. That’s where the owners of real estate post most of their ads.

We create unique rental offer: Professional photos and interesting site description, considering its features. Identifying the target audience. We monitor the rental market and able to use advertising tools and search for guests. Posting the real estate on all leading rental portals. Optimal visibility. GOAL: Maximum visibility and high interest in the real estate

We carefully weigh changes in the rental market. Personal manager, positive reviews are the key to the success, furnishing is the perfect balance, seasonal changes constantly changed ads. After each check-out, we contact the guests and clarify whether they liked everything, whether everything corresponded to the description, and ask them to leave feedback. This is very important for us because it affects the rating of a real estate with the search engines.

It is easy and quick to get started with us. We will give you step-by-step recommendations for transferring your property to our management. To get started, we will only need valid documents for the property and your existing reservations. Based on this information, we check documents, inspect real estate, prepare a marketing plan and post your real estate property on relevant sites. Let’s succeed together wasting no time!
